horizontal 'peek' carousel (~6 thumbs ~150-170px, radius ~14-18px, one ring-selected, bleeds off right edge) + sectioned vertical grid under 'Wallspace's Pick' header
n/a — not the pattern; hero here is a featured-content banner: eyebrow + title + spec metadata + one frosted capsule CTA + heart, over full-bleed photo
featured-hero banner: full-bleed cinematic photo with bottom-left text stack and glass CTA (App Store Discover / Apple TV grammar)

signature_moves: Storefront-hero transplant — App Store Discover / Apple TV grammar (full-bleed cinematic hero + glass CTA + peeking carousels) applied to a Mac wallpaper utility; systematic and purposeful but a borrowed template identity, competent-generic not bespoke
Spec sheet under a cinematic title — resolution + file size ('3840x2160  85MB') sits directly beneath the glossy headline; utility honesty poking through the glossy shell, the one app-specific choice
defects: Glass-in-content — frosted 'View Wallpaper' capsule and translucent top bar are glass sitting on photographic content; native glass is floating-chrome-only with content opaque
Segmented control as main navigation — Home|Explore|Library filled-pill does view switching; HIG names this a non-native mistake (use a tab view/sidebar; a toolbar is not a tab bar)
Faked chrome — third traffic light gray not green on a focused window; hand-drawn branded header instead of NSToolbar anatomy
Tracked-uppercase eyebrow — 'FEATURED' is a web/marketing convention, not native sentence-case system-font labeling
Contrast Dilution over imagery — secondary-white text and hairline frosted controls risk <4.5:1 / <3:1 over mid-tone photo regions without a guaranteed legibility scrim

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product crossed with photographic drench — a dark-neutral consumer media storefront (glass overlays on full-bleed imagery)

psychology: Aesthetic-usability effect — heavy investment in the 50ms cinematic hero buys perceived quality; apt for an app whose value is visual, but the halo does not excuse the native-chrome failures
Von Restorff / Von Restorff one-primary-CTA — a single frosted 'View Wallpaper' pill stands alone against quiet surroundings (correct)
Jakob's Law — borrows the App Store/streaming storefront schema so browsing is instantly legible (good), yet violates Jakob's Law at the OS layer by faking non-native Mac chrome and nav
Hick's Law — navigation reduced to three clear scopes (Home/Explore/Library), low decision cost at the top-level choice point
Serial-position effect — Featured hero leads; carousel 'peek' bleed exploits curiosity to pull horizontal exploration
notes: ONLY input is a marketing cover composite (cover.jpg, 1440x900); the app window is tilted in 3-D perspective inside a branded backdrop, so every measurement is (estimated) with wide ranges and the retina scale is unknown. No raw screenshots and no shot-* files were supplied. Lineage (web-electron, low confidence) rests on styling idioms — filled-segment pill as top nav, tracked-uppercase eyebrow, glass-pill-over-photo, gray third traffic light — not on a clean screenshot; it could be a stylized SwiftUI mock or an idealized render. EXCLUDE from macOS canon; treat as consumer-storefront contrast evidence only. icon.png (512², dark rounded-square + white 4-point sparkle) was supplied but not digested (Workflow A only) — flag for a Workflow B icon pass. Left half of cover is brand evidence (wordmark, laurel '2026 Wallpapers' badge, 'The Ultimate Wallpaper App' bold-grotesk headline, hex watermark), kept separate from app-window evidence. Corpus is Novice (this is the first app profile; kit already ingested).
